principle: Agents propose and organize. Deterministic tools compute. Reproduction determines what survives.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.purpose: Routes work through schemas, permissions, and scientific gates.

agents.name: Literature agent
agents.purpose: Finds sources and extracts narrow, citable claims with locations and licenses.

agents.name: Candidate agent
agents.purpose: Turns a hypothesis into a versioned candidate that fits the public schema.

agents.name: Math and GR agent
agents.purpose: Prepares deterministic symbolic or numerical tasks and records conventions.

agents.name: Skeptic agent
agents.purpose: Searches for hidden assumptions, coordinate mistakes, weak evidence, and failed convergence.

agents.name: Reproduction agent
agents.purpose: Runs pinned artifacts in a clean environment and compares scientific fingerprints.
may_not: declare independence when sharing the same implementation

agents.name: Explainer agent
agents.purpose: Creates beginner and technical explanations from the same verified result object.

agents.name: Search-policy agent
agents.purpose: Proposes the next experiment from a frozen graph snapshot and transparent objective.

agents.name: Graph curator
agents.purpose: Proposes deduplication, supersession, and graph links while preserving provenance.
may_not: mix product telemetry with scientific evidence
